hero.title: Tantia University
hero.summary: Tantia University offers agricultural study in Sri Ganganagar through its Faculty of Agriculture. Undergraduate agriculture began in 2015-16, and the faculty describes an irrigated farm, laboratories and residential facilities. Its published fee brochure distinguishes admission channels and must be read with its stated year.

overview.heading: Agriculture learning in Sri Ganganagar
paragraphs: Tantia’s agriculture faculty introduced its four-year B.Sc. Agriculture programme in the 2015-16 academic session. The official programme catalogue also lists two-year agricultural master’s study across crop, soil, horticultural, economic and extension subjects. These subject choices provide a useful distinction between a broad undergraduate course and later agricultural specialisation.

The faculty’s infrastructure page describes an irrigated agriculture farm for technical training, together with laboratories and library facilities. The university’s revised 2025-26 brochure gives separate B.Sc. fee rows for JET and CUET. The fee distinction is historical evidence for that session and should not be carried into another admission year without a fresh schedule.

admissions.heading: Planning an agriculture application
admissions.intro: The university provides an admission-procedure page and programme enquiry routes. For agriculture, request a current notice confirming whether the intended application is through JET, CUET or another permitted category, together with the corresponding payable charges.

steps.title: Confirm the course
steps.text: Use the official programme contact to confirm that the listed degree is taking applications for your intended intake.

steps.title: Request the intake notice
steps.text: Ask for the applicable selection rules, fee breakdown and document checklist before submitting an application.

campus.heading: Irrigated farm and residential learning resources
campus.intro: The faculty describes an agriculture farm with irrigation for technical training. Its account also identifies classrooms, laboratories, library facilities and separate boys’ and girls’ hostels; its undated hostel price is not treated as current.

faqs.question: When did Tantia introduce undergraduate agriculture?
faqs.answer: The faculty account dates the B.Sc. programme to 2015-16.

faqs.question: What school streams does the catalogue list?
faqs.answer: The undergraduate catalogue accepts 10+2 PCM, PCB or Agriculture; an intake-specific minimum-marks notice remains necessary.

faqs.question: Why are two historical B.Sc. fees mentioned?
faqs.answer: The 2025-26 brochure has separate JET and CUET tuition rows, INR 58,000 and INR 70,000 per year respectively.

faqs.question: Is there a training farm?
faqs.answer: The faculty describes an agriculture farm with irrigation for field technical learning.

faqs.question: Are master’s subjects included in the checked ICAR entry?
faqs.answer: The audited Faculty of Agriculture row explicitly names B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture. Other advertised degrees are not added to that scope.
